jsonbench.score_formula: geomean((Sirix seconds + .010) / (ClickHouse seconds + .010)); lower is better
jsonbench.interpretation: Warm geometric score wins in both rounds. Warm total elapsed time remains higher for Sirix; Q3 and Q5 remain slower and Q2 is near parity.
jsonbench.cold_scope: Fresh process after fsync, fadvise and zero mincore residency on visible files. eCryptfs lower filesystem cache uncontrolled; these are not verified disk-cold rankings.

cold_io_evidence.interpretation: Unequal lower cache state is an inference from the stacked filesystem and observed I/O; no like-for-like disk-cold regression or victory is established.

same_database_control.interpretation: No broad query regression; small Q4 warm difference retained. Visible-eviction comparisons are confounded by changing I/O.

clickbench.interpretation: Timing direction reverses between ABBA and BAAB, with differences within observed run spread. No consistent regression in this 200K-row screen; not a full-scale test or proof of equivalence.

completed_diagnostic_profile.interpretation: Includes CPU, wall and allocation events. Inclusive paths overlap; do not add percentages. Cache hits are preallocated, but read misses and other loader paths allocate. Different windows prevent a matched allocation reduction claim against the earlier failed load.
